Ten Hag comments on Ronaldo's performance and Manchester United tenure

Manchester United manager Erik ten Hag stated that Cristiano Ronaldo has not been able to deliver for the team for the past 7-8 years. Ten Hag managed Manchester United between April 2022 and October 2024. During this period, Ronaldo was benched by Ten Hag following a slow start to the season.
